TEXT.source: ['3. aney o ango ko!', '還我林投果！', 'Give back my pandanus!', '', 'si apen Kotan/Jinovoy (M, 75, Yayo)', '王仁德，男，75，椰油村', '']

S.FORM: am-ian namen do Jimasapaw am, am sinodo ji pa mi-agza o dehdeh, tey-má-kcin namen a, a ikong o kan-en nokakoa,
S.PHON: amian namən ɖ[o|u] ʥimaʂapaw am am ʂin[o|u]ɖ[o|u] ʥi pa miagʐa [o|u] ɖəʁɖəʁ təjm*kcin namən a a ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] kanən n[o|u]kak[o|u]a
S.FORM: amian namen do Jimasapaw am, am sinodo ji pa miagza o dehdeh, teymakcin namen a, a ikong o kanen nokakoa,
S.PHON: amian namən ɖ[o|u] ʥimaʂapaw am am ɕin[o|u]ɖ[o|u] ʥi pa miagra [o|u] ɖəɰɖəɰ təjmakʨin namən a a ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] kanən n[o|u]kak[o|u]a
S.TRANSL: 我們走到Jimasapaw時，還不到外地人吃午飯的時間，我們就已經很餓了； 以前哪有什麼可吃的東西？
As we walked to Jimasapaw, it wasn't time for people from the outside to eat lunch yet, but we were already hungry. There never used to be anything to eat.

S.FORM: "mo ke-hakay" koan ko am, "ikong", "o ito so ya map-adon so ya todaji ma-kamak a ango a, hap-en ta an,
S.PHON: m[o|u] kəʁakaj k[o|u]an k[o|u] am ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] it[o|u] ʂ[o|u] ja mapaɖ[o|u]n ʂ[o|u] ja t[o|u]ɖaʥi makamak a aŋ[o|u] a ʁapən ta an
S.FORM: "mo kehakay" koan ko am, "ikong", "o ito so ya mapadon so ya todaji makamak a ango a, hapen ta an,
S.PHON: m[o|u] kəɰakaj k[o|u]an k[o|u] am ik[o|u]ŋ [o|u] it[o|u] ʂ[o|u] ja mapaɖ[o|u]n ʂ[o|u] ja t[o|u]ɖaʥi makamak a aŋ[o|u] a ɰapən ta an
S.TRANSL: 我說＂喂！＂ ＂什麼事？＂ ＂你看那個人的揹籃上面擺了一個成熟的林投果，我們去把它拿下來好不好？
"Hey!" I said. "What?" "Look at that very ripe pandanus put on top of that person's basket! Why don't we go get it?

S.FORM: i-toro ko jimo a, i-palayo mo" koan ko a, "a nohon" koan na, a pasobna-an na yaken an.
S.PHON: it[o|u]r[o|u] k[o|u] ʥim[o|u] a ipalaj[o|u] m[o|u] k[o|u]an k[o|u] a a n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n k[o|u]an na a paʂ[o|u]bnaan na jakən an
S.FORM: itoro ko jimo a, ipalayo mo" koan ko a, "a nohon" koan na, a pasobnaan na yaken an.
S.PHON: it[o|u]ɻ[o|u] k[o|u] ʥim[o|u] a ipalaj[o|u] m[o|u] k[o|u]an k[o|u] a a n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n k[o|u]an na a paʂ[o|u]bnaan na jakən an
S.TRANSL: 我（去拿）給你，你就帶著跑＂ 我說，＂好啊＂ 他說。反正他對我從來不會有異議的
"I'll throw it to you, and you run with it." "Okay," he said, for he never opposed me.

S.FORM: to namen rana a-sinmo am, "ka-vakes kong!" koan ko a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən rana aʂinm[o|u] am kavakəʂ k[o|u]ŋ k[o|u]an k[o|u] a
S.FORM: to namen rana asinmo am, "kavakes kong!" koan ko a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən ɻana aɕinm[o|u] am kafakəʂ k[o|u]ŋ k[o|u]an k[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 後來我們迎面遇上了（那個女人），我就說＂（女性朋友）你好！＂
I went over to meet the woman, and greeted her, "Hello!"

S.FORM: ta iya rana ori am, mina mavakes na sio ni mina Cikno sio, a mina ka-gaga-n ko am, o ri o rako a mavakes a,
S.PHON: ta ija rana [o|u]ri am mina mavakəʂ na ʂi[o|u] ni mina cikn[o|u] ʂi[o|u] a mina kagagan k[o|u] am [o|u] ri [o|u] rak[o|u] a mavakəʂ a
S.FORM: ta iya rana ori am, mina mavakes na sio ni mina Cikno sio, a mina kagagan ko am, o ri o rako a mavakes a,
S.PHON: ta ija ɻana [o|u]ɻi am mina mafakəʂ na ɕi[o|u] ni mina ʨikn[o|u] ɕi[o|u] a mina kagagan k[o|u] am [o|u] ɻi [o|u] ɻak[o|u] a mafakəʂ a
S.TRANSL: 她呢，就是我已故的朋友si Cikno之妻，那女人個兒滿高壯的
She was my friend si Cikno's wife and she was tall and strong.

S.FORM: ratateng am, "a ya mo i-pang-asi, mo Sezez, mo pang-amay? ko imo i-ciapaw a ji niri-siring-a, mo pang-amay" koan na,
S.PHON: ratatəŋ am a ja m[o|u] ipaŋaʂi m[o|u] ʂəʐəʐ m[o|u] paŋamaj k[o|u] im[o|u] iciapaw a ʥi niriʂiriŋa m[o|u] paŋamaj k[o|u]an na
S.FORM: ratateng am, "a ya mo ipangasi, mo Sezez, mo pangamay? ko imo iciapaw a ji nirisiringa, mo pangamay" koan na,
S.PHON: ɻatatəŋ am a ja m[o|u] ipaŋaɕi m[o|u] ʂərər m[o|u] paŋamaj k[o|u] im[o|u] iʨiapaw a ʥi niɻiɕiɻiŋa m[o|u] paŋamaj k[o|u]an na
S.TRANSL: 後來，她說＂你少來了！死Sezez，我才懶得理你呢！＂
"Who are you greeting? Why should I pay any attention to you, snotty si Sezez?"

S.FORM: ratateng am, likod-an na yamen am, to ko ngatkát-a do tey-ngato no yala na o,
S.PHON: ratatəŋ am lik[o|u]ɖan na jamən am t[o|u] k[o|u] ŋatk*ta ɖ[o|u] təjŋat[o|u] n[o|u] jala na [o|u]
S.FORM: ratateng am, likodan na yamen am, to ko ngatkata do teyngato no yala na o,
S.PHON: ɻatatəŋ am lik[o|u]ɖan na jamən am t[o|u] k[o|u] ŋatkata ɖ[o|u] təjŋat[o|u] n[o|u] jala na [o|u]
S.TRANSL: 就在跟她擦身而過之際，我即轉身抓取了她背上的林投果，
Just as she brushed past me, I turned and took the pandanus out of her basket.

S.FORM: a ji a-kmi vanga o ango a, to ko noró-an ji apen Sidongen am, to na malayó-an am,
S.PHON: a ʥi akmi vaŋa [o|u] aŋ[o|u] a t[o|u] k[o|u] n[o|u]r*an ʥi apən ʂiɖ[o|u]ŋən am t[o|u] na malaj*an am
S.FORM: a ji akmi vanga o ango a, to ko noroan ji apen Sidongen am, to na malayoan am,
S.PHON: a ʥi akmi faŋa [o|u] aŋ[o|u] a t[o|u] k[o|u] n[o|u]ɻ[o|u]an ʥi apən ɕiɖ[o|u]ŋən am t[o|u] na malaj[o|u]an am
S.TRANSL: 那林投果像一個鍋子那麼大。我拿到之後就丟給了si apen Sidongen，然後他拿了就跑
That pandanus was as big as a pot. Once I got it, I immediately threw it to si apen Sidongen. Once he caught it, he ran.

S.FORM: to nóngay o mavakes ori am, liliw-en na o apid-an na am, má-paw a, "a ajin do jia ori o ya ma-réhmet ang?", to na amtád-an am,
S.PHON: t[o|u] n*ŋaj [o|u] mavakəʂ [o|u]ri am liliwən na [o|u] apiɖan na am m*paw a a aʥin ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u]ri [o|u] ja mar*ʁmət aŋ t[o|u] na amt*ɖan am
S.FORM: to nongay o mavakes ori am, liliwen na o apidan na am, mapaw a, "a ajin do jia ori o ya marehmet ang?", to na amtadan am,
S.PHON: t[o|u] n[o|u]ŋaj [o|u] mafakəʂ [o|u]ɻi am liliwən na [o|u] apiɖan na am mapaw a a aʥin ɖ[o|u] ʥia [o|u]ɻi [o|u] ja maɻəɰmət aŋ t[o|u] na amtaɖan am
S.TRANSL: 那女人往前一走，感覺到揹的東西變輕了，於是放下籃子看看，＂奇怪，剛才揹的重物到哪裡去了？＂
The woman had only walked a few steps when she noticed her basket was considerably lighter, and she thought, "Where have the heavy things gone?" and she put her basket down to look.

S.FORM: "a ya nio ni-ha-hap o ri, mo Sezez a, mo mina Vekeh" koan na am,
S.PHON: a ja ni[o|u] niʁaʁap [o|u] ri m[o|u] ʂəʐəʐ a m[o|u] mina vəkəʁ k[o|u]an na am
S.FORM: "a ya nio nihahap o ri, mo Sezez a, mo mina Vekeh" koan na am,
S.PHON: a ja ni[o|u] niɰaɰap [o|u] ɻi m[o|u] ʂərər a m[o|u] mina fəkəɰ k[o|u]an na am
S.TRANSL: ＂喂！Sezez，死si Vekeh！是你們拿走了（林投果）嗎？＂
"Hey! Sezez, damn si Vekeh! Did you steal my pandanus?"

S.FORM: ke-kezdas na am, to maláyo a m-ai jiamen am, ori a k-aong na jiamen a.
S.PHON: kəkəʐɖaʂ na am t[o|u] mal*j[o|u] a mai ʥiamən am [o|u]ri a ka[o|u]ŋ na ʥiamən a
S.FORM: kekezdas na am, to malayo a mai jiamen am, ori a kaong na jiamen a.
S.PHON: kəkərɖaʂ na am t[o|u] malaj[o|u] a mai ʥiamən am [o|u]ɻi a ka[o|u]ŋ na ʥiamən a
S.TRANSL: 後來她就拿著鐮刀跑來追砍我們
She picked up her sickle and chased after us,

S.FORM: am-ian rana do a-arang-an am, "na, o ito do Jikavatoan rana a, to ta rana pa-panála do jia,
S.PHON: amian rana ɖ[o|u] aaraŋan am na [o|u] it[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ʥikavat[o|u]an rana a t[o|u] ta rana papan*la ɖ[o|u] ʥia
S.FORM: amian rana do aarangan am, "na, o ito do Jikavatoan rana a, to ta rana papanala do jia,
S.PHON: amian ɻana ɖ[o|u] aaɻaŋan am na [o|u] it[o|u] ɖ[o|u] ʥikafat[o|u]an ɻana a t[o|u] ta ɻana papanala ɖ[o|u] ʥia
S.TRANSL: 我們到了海邊停放船處時，＂ㄟ，她在Jikavatoan了，不如我們就在這裡等她吧
until we reached the harbor. "She's almost at Jikavatoan, so why don't we just stop and wait for her here?"

S.FORM: ta to ta rana mika-ra-roá-i a ka-sanga-sangab ta sia pori-poris-en, vonong mo o na pinan-an a, vonong ko o ai-ai na,
S.PHON: ta t[o|u] ta rana mikarar[o|u]*i a kaʂaŋaʂaŋab ta ʂia p[o|u]rip[o|u]riʂən v[o|u]n[o|u]ŋ m[o|u] [o|u] na pinanan a v[o|u]n[o|u]ŋ k[o|u] [o|u] aiai na
S.FORM: ta to ta rana mikararoai a kasangasangab ta sia poriporisen, vonong mo o na pinanan a, vonong ko o aiai na,
S.PHON: ta t[o|u] ta ɻana mikaɻaɻ[o|u]ai a kaʂaŋaʂaŋab ta ɕia p[o|u]ɻip[o|u]ɻiʂən f[o|u]n[o|u]ŋ m[o|u] [o|u] na pinanan a f[o|u]n[o|u]ŋ k[o|u] [o|u] aiai na
S.TRANSL: 我們兩個一起來（修理她），你負責搶她手上的東西，我負責（纏住）她的腳
"The two of us can easily rough her up. You take what she is holding, and I'll tangle up her legs

W.TRANSL: 虛.動綴-疊-兩人合力-處焦.虛

S.FORM: a ka-za-zasag ta jia, a ikong na to níwciw-i jiaten?", "nohon", a pasobna-an na yaken an,
S.PHON: a kaʐaʐaʂag ta ʥia a ik[o|u]ŋ na t[o|u] n*wciwi ʥiatən n[o|u]ʁ[o|u]n a paʂ[o|u]bnaan na jakən an
S.FORM: a kazazasag ta jia, a ikong na to niwciwi jiaten?", "nohon", a pasobnaan na yaken an,
S.PHON: a kararaʂag ta ʥia a ik[o|u]ŋ na t[o|u] niwʨiwi ʥiatən n[o|u]ɰ[o|u]n a paʂ[o|u]bnaan na jakən an
S.TRANSL: 然後用力的把她踩在腳下，誰叫她來追我們？＂ ＂好！＂ 反正他不會對我有異議
and keep her down with my feet. Why is she chasing us?" "Sure." Has he ever had a different opinion from mine?

S.FORM: to namen pa-panála am, todaji maka-ránes am, "ci m-ai kamo pala cimaraw" koan na am, to na mi-oli ori a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən papan*la am t[o|u]ɖaʥi makar*nəʂ am ci mai kam[o|u] pala cimaraw k[o|u]an na am t[o|u] na mi[o|u]li [o|u]ri a
S.FORM: to namen papanala am, todaji makaranes am, "ci mai kamo pala cimaraw" koan na am, to na mioli ori a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən papanala am t[o|u]ɖaʥi makaɻanəʂ am ʨi mai kam[o|u] pala ʨimaɻaw k[o|u]an na am t[o|u] na mi[o|u]li [o|u]ɻi a
S.TRANSL: 我們就在那裡等著。當她快到的時候，她就對我們說＂明天你們來的時候，等著瞧吧＂ ，然後就折回去了
There we waited. When she was in sight, she said, "Just wait, I'll get you tomorrow," and turned back for home.

S.FORM: to namen rana os-a Jizakazang a, "o ito a, ya rana m-ian Jimasapaw o ya ta ni-a-hap-an so ango", "ey! akan o ya" koan namen o rako a ango a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən rana [o|u]ʂa ʥiʐakaʐaŋ a [o|u] it[o|u] a ja rana mian ʥimaʂapaw [o|u] ja ta niaʁapan ʂ[o|u] aŋ[o|u] əj akan [o|u] ja k[o|u]an namən [o|u] rak[o|u] a aŋ[o|u] a
S.FORM: to namen rana osa Jizakazang a, "o ito a, ya rana mian Jimasapaw o ya ta niahapan so ango", "ey! akan o ya" koan namen o rako a ango a,
S.PHON: t[o|u] namən ɻana [o|u]ʂa ʥirakaraŋ a [o|u] it[o|u] a ja ɻana mian ʥimaʂapaw [o|u] ja ta niaɰapan ʂ[o|u] aŋ[o|u] əj akan [o|u] ja k[o|u]an namən [o|u] ɻak[o|u] a aŋ[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 我們在Jizakazang一邊吃著林投果，一邊看著折返回去的那女人，說，＂看啊，被我們搶了林投果的那個女人已經到了Jimasapaw＂ 。＂喂，來吃（大林投果）哦！＂
We ate the pandanus at Jizkazang as we watched the woman walk away. "Look, the woman who we stole from is already at Jimasapaw"." Come on! Come and eat the big pandanus!"

S.FORM: ji namen ni-pi-sir-siring si ke-hakay a, ika-doa na araw am, ji á-ni-m-ai si apen Sidongen ito a,
S.PHON: ʥi namən nipiʂirʂiriŋ ʂi kəʁakaj a ikaɖ[o|u]a na araw am ʥi *nimai ʂi apən ʂiɖ[o|u]ŋən it[o|u] a
S.FORM: ji namen nipisirsiring si kehakay a, ikadoa na araw am, ji animai si apen Sidongen ito a,
S.PHON: ʥi namən nipiɕiɻɕiɻiŋ ɕi kəɰakaj a ikaɖ[o|u]a na aɻaw am ʥi animai ɕi apən ɕiɖ[o|u]ŋən it[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 我們兩個好朋友事先也沒有講好。第二天的時候si apen Sidongen居然沒有上學校
We didn't discuss anything that day. The next day, si apen Sidongen (surprisingly) didn't come to school.

S.FORM: ji ko a-nake-nakem ori o mina ka-hap namen sia ori a, am-ian do Jikanayopan do vahay da no Lan'en am, to namen a-sinmo a,
S.PHON: ʥi k[o|u] anakənakəm [o|u]ri [o|u] mina kaʁap namən ʂia [o|u]ri a amian ɖ[o|u] ʥikanaj[o|u]pan ɖ[o|u] vaʁaj ɖa n[o|u] lanʔən am t[o|u] namən aʂinm[o|u] a
S.FORM: ji ko anakenakem ori o mina kahap namen sia ori a, amian do Jikanayopan do vahay da no Lan'en am, to namen asinmo a,
S.PHON: ʥi k[o|u] anakənakəm [o|u]ɻi [o|u] mina kaɰap namən ɕia [o|u]ɻi a amian ɖ[o|u] ʥikanaj[o|u]pan ɖ[o|u] faɰaj ɖa n[o|u] lanʔən am t[o|u] namən aɕinm[o|u] a
S.TRANSL: 對於曾經搶過別人的林投果一事，我早已忘了。偏偏我們走到Jikanayopan處，即蘭恩目前的所在處時，又遇上了她
I had totally forgotten about the theft. As I walked to Jikanayopan, where Lan'en is located, I saw her again.

S.FORM: "o ito si koito a, ikong na cita-en ni koito" koan no karoan namen am, i-pa-makong na o ke-kezdas na,
S.PHON: [o|u] it[o|u] ʂi k[o|u]it[o|u] a ik[o|u]ŋ na citaən ni k[o|u]it[o|u] k[o|u]an n[o|u] kar[o|u]an namən am ipamak[o|u]ŋ na [o|u] kəkəʐɖaʂ na
S.FORM: "o ito si koito a, ikong na citaen ni koito" koan no karoan namen am, ipamakong na o kekezdas na,
S.PHON: [o|u] it[o|u] ɕi k[o|u]it[o|u] a ik[o|u]ŋ na ʨitaən ni k[o|u]it[o|u] k[o|u]an n[o|u] kaɻ[o|u]an namən am ipamak[o|u]ŋ na [o|u] kəkərɖaʂ na
S.TRANSL: 我們其它的同學說＂你看那個人，她在找什麼呀？＂ 她高舉著鐮刀作預備砍划的手勢
"Look, what is she looking for?" other classmates said. She held up a sickle and pretended she was ready to kill.

S.FORM: "ajin jia si Sezez" koan na, "a ken ito do pa-na-navak na",
S.PHON: aʥin ʥia ʂi ʂəʐəʐ k[o|u]an na a kən it[o|u] ɖ[o|u] pananavak na
S.FORM: "ajin jia si Sezez" koan na, "a ken ito do pananavak na",
S.PHON: aʥin ʥia ɕi ʂərər k[o|u]an na a kən it[o|u] ɖ[o|u] pananafak na
S.TRANSL: 她說＂si Sezez在哪裡？＂ ，＂在中間那裡啊＂
"Where is si Sezez?" she asked."He's in the middle."

S.FORM: "ta ya mo kala-n jiaken" koan ko am, "a to mo ngap-i so ango, mo ka-vazat" koan na am,
S.PHON: ta ja m[o|u] kalan ʥiakən k[o|u]an k[o|u] am a t[o|u] m[o|u] ŋapi ʂ[o|u] aŋ[o|u] m[o|u] kavaʐat k[o|u]an na am
S.FORM: "ta ya mo kalan jiaken" koan ko am, "a to mo ngapi so ango, mo kavazat" koan na am,
S.PHON: ta ja m[o|u] kalan ʥiakən k[o|u]an k[o|u] am a t[o|u] m[o|u] ŋapi ʂ[o|u] aŋ[o|u] m[o|u] kafarat k[o|u]an na am
S.TRANSL: 我說＂你找我幹什麼？＂ 她說＂可惡，你為什麼拿走我的林投果？＂
"What's up?" I said. "Damn! Why did you steal my pandanus?" she asked.

S.FORM: to ko monas-a jia o ke-kezdas na am, to ko vozcín-a am, to ko walít-an do ka-ango-an am,
